name: create_react_counter_component
description: Creates a React Counter function component rendered via renderToStaticMarkup
prompts: Create a file counter.js that exports a React function component named Counter (module.exports = { Counter };). The component accepts a single prop `count` (a number) and renders a <div> whose text content is exactly `Count: <count>` (for example, for count=5 it renders 'Count: 5'). Do not use JSX syntax - build the element with React.createElement(...) so the file can be required directly by plain Node without a build step. Do not call ReactDOM.render or start any server; just export the component.
